q: The designer of the Nigerian national flag in 1959 was Mr. ____. (P2)
explain: Pa Michael Taiwo Akinkunmi designed the flag as a student in 1959.

q: The two white horses on the Nigerian Coat of Arms represent ____. (P2)
explain: The two supporting horses symbolize national dignity.

q: The red eagle perched on top of the Coat of Arms represents national ____. (P2)
explain: The eagle represents national strength and vision.

q: The black shield on the Nigerian Coat of Arms represents Nigeria's ____. (P2)
explain: The black shield represents the fertile land and rich soil of Nigeria.

q: The silvery 'Y' shape on the Coat of Arms represents Rivers ____. (P2)
explain: The Y-shape marks the confluence of Rivers Niger and Benue.

q: Civic duty (P2): Paying taxes promptly to the government is a civic ____.
explain: duty / obligation is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): Protecting public utilities like streetlights and water pipes is the responsibility of ____.
explain: all citizens is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): A citizen should always obey lawful orders from the ____.
explain: police and courts is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): Treating people of different ethnic groups and religions with kindness is called ____.
explain: tolerance and unity is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): Which of these is a civic responsibility of a student in school?
explain: Keeping the school compound clean is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): A child's right to life, healthcare, and education is protected by the ____ Act.
explain: Child Rights is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): When singing the National Anthem, citizens should ____.
explain: stand upright and pay attention is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): The Independent Corrupt Practices Commission is abbreviated as ____.
explain: ICPC is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): Refusing to join secret cults and violence in school demonstrates moral ____.
explain: courage and discipline is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P2): The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) was established in 1973 to promote national ____.
explain: unity and integration is the essential civic principle.
